section.content: The utility model belongs to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a biotechnological gene detection device, which comprises: the detection device comprises a frame, a groove, a driving assembly and a gene detection module, wherein the groove is formed in the bottom of the frame, the driving assemblies are arranged on the tops of two side plates of the frame, and the gene detection module is connected with the movable end of the driving assembly; the movable placing rack is arranged on the groove and comprises an electric slide rail, an electric slider and a placing plate, the electric slide rail is arranged in the groove, the electric slider is arranged on the electric slide rail, the movable protecting mechanism utilizes the hydraulic cylinder to drive the protecting cover to lift, the internal structure of the detecting device is exposed, the movable placing rack drives the placing plate to slide out through the electric slider, and therefore a worker can place and take a detection sample conveniently and can use the detection sample conveniently.

本实用新型属于基因检测技术领域，具体为一种生物技术基因检测装置，其包括：检测装置、活动放置架和活动防护机构，检测装置包括框架、凹槽、驱动组件和基因检测模块，所述框架底部开设凹槽，所述框架两侧板顶部设置驱动组件，所述基因检测模块与驱动组件活动端连接；活动放置架设置在所述凹槽上，所述活动放置架包括电动滑轨、电动滑块和放置板，所述电动滑轨设置在凹槽内，所述电动滑轨上设置电动滑块，活动防护机构利用液压缸带动防护盖升起，使检测装置内部结构露出，活动放置架通过电动滑块带动放置板滑出，方便工作人员放置和拿取检测样品，便于工作人员使用。

Biotechnological gene detection deviceTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of gene detection, in particular to a biotechnology gene detection device.

Background

After the gene information of the membrane cell or other histiocyte is amplified, the DNA molecular information in the cell of the detected person is detected by a specific device, the risk of the body suffering from diseases is predicted, and various gene conditions contained in the cell are analyzed, so that people can know the gene information of themselves, and the occurrence of the diseases is avoided or delayed by improving the living environment and the living habits of the people.

Disclosed in patent No. CN201621317175.6 is a biotechnological gene detection device, the base sets up to the flute profile, the base up end is equipped with two sets of board-like guide rails and every board-like guide rail of group and sets up with the horizontal central line symmetry of base, the centre of fly leaf is equipped with the nut, the spiro union has the screw rod in the nut, the both ends of screw rod are all rotated and are connected the mount, one side of base is equipped with two motor mounting panels, install the rotation motor on the motor mounting panel, be equipped with in the recess of base and place the board, the lower terminal surface of fly leaf is equipped with the telescopic link, the lower extreme of telescopic link is equipped with gene detection module. This biotechnology gene detection device, rational in infrastructure, the practicality is strong, and the setting of two sets of board-like guide rails has improved detection efficiency greatly, and the board of placing that gene detection module below two sets of fly leafs detected does not coincide moreover, avoids two sets of detection device collisions, adopts high accuracy brushless motor, and control is accurate, avoids the error.

Above-mentioned gene detection device places the board and is located the below of driver part and gene detection module when using, because the effect of sheltering from of driver part and gene detection module, the personnel of not being convenient for place and the operation of taking the sample.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

This section is for the purpose of summarizing some aspects of embodiments of the utility model and to briefly introduce some preferred embodiments. Some simplifications or omissions may be made in this section as well as in the abstract of the specification and the title of the application to avoid obscuring the purpose of this section, the abstract of the specification and the title of the application, and such simplifications or omissions are not intended to limit the scope of the utility model.

The present invention has been made in view of the above and/or other problems occurring in the prior art gene assaying devices.

Therefore, the utility model aims to provide a biotechnological gene detection device, which adopts a movable placing rack and a movable protection mechanism, wherein the movable protection mechanism is used for protecting the detection device externally, when in use, the movable protection mechanism utilizes a hydraulic cylinder to drive a protection cover to lift, so that the internal structure of the detection device is exposed, and the movable placing rack drives a placing plate to slide out through an electric sliding block, so that a worker can place and take a detection sample conveniently, and the detection device is convenient for the worker to use.

To solve the above technical problem, according to an aspect of the present invention, the present invention provides the following technical solutions:

a biotech gene testing device, comprising:

the detection device comprises a frame, a groove, a driving assembly and a gene detection module, wherein the bottom of the frame is provided with the groove, the tops of two side plates of the frame are provided with the driving assembly, and the gene detection module is connected with the movable end of the driving assembly;

the movable placing rack is arranged on the groove and comprises an electric sliding rail, an electric sliding block and a placing plate, the electric sliding rail is arranged in the groove, the electric sliding block is arranged on the electric sliding rail, and the placing plate in contact with the bottom of the frame is arranged on the electric sliding block;

the movable protection mechanism is arranged on the frame and comprises a protection cover, a convex block and hydraulic cylinders, the protection cover and the frame are mutually embedded to form a closed structure, the convex block is arranged on two sides of the protection cover, and the hydraulic cylinders are connected and fixed on two sides of the frame through the convex block.

As a preferable embodiment of the biotechnological gene detecting apparatus according to the utility model, there is provided: the driving assembly adopts a screw motor to drive the movable block to move, and the gene detection module is connected to the movable block.

As a preferable embodiment of the biotechnological gene detecting apparatus according to the utility model, there is provided: and horizontal ground feet are uniformly distributed at the bottom of the frame.

As a preferable embodiment of the biotechnological gene detecting apparatus according to the utility model, there is provided: the protective cover adopts transparent casing, the protective cover is provided with sealed the pad with the hookup location of frame.

As a preferable embodiment of the biotechnological gene detecting apparatus according to the utility model, there is provided: and a ball is arranged between the frame and the placing plate and is embedded at the bottom of the frame.

Compared with the prior art: according to the utility model, the movable placing rack and the movable protection mechanism are adopted, the movable protection mechanism is used for protecting the detection device externally, the movable protection mechanism utilizes the hydraulic cylinder to drive the protection cover to lift, so that the internal structure of the detection device is exposed, the movable placing rack drives the placing plate to slide out through the electric sliding block, the detection sample can be conveniently placed and taken by a worker, and the use of the worker is facilitated.

Drawings

In order to more clearly illustrate the technical solutions of the embodiments of the present invention, the present invention will be described in detail with reference to the accompanying drawings and detailed embodiments, and it is obvious that the drawings in the following description are only some embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious for those skilled in the art to obtain other drawings without inventive exercise. Wherein:

FIG. 1 is a schematic side view of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a schematic structural diagram of a detecting device according to the present invention;

FIG. 3 is a schematic view of the movable rack of the present invention;

fig. 4 is a schematic structural diagram of the movable protection mechanism of the present invention.

In the figure: 100 detection devices, 110 frames, 120 grooves, 130 driving components, 140 gene detection modules, 200 movable placing racks, 210 electric sliding rails, 220 electric sliding blocks, 230 placing plates, 300 movable protection mechanisms, 310 protection covers, 320 bumps and 330 hydraulic cylinders.

Detailed Description

In order to make the aforementioned objects, features and advantages of the present invention comprehensible, embodiments accompanied with figures are described in detail below.

In the following description, numerous specific details are set forth in order to provide a thorough understanding of the present invention, but the present invention may be practiced in other ways than those specifically described herein, and it will be apparent to those of ordinary skill in the art that the present invention may be practiced without departing from the spirit and scope of the present invention, and therefore the present invention is not limited to the specific embodiments disclosed below.

Next, the present invention will be described in detail with reference to the drawings, wherein for convenience of illustration, the cross-sectional view of the device structure is not enlarged partially according to the general scale, and the drawings are only examples, which should not limit the scope of the present invention. In addition, the three-dimensional dimensions of length, width and depth should be included in the actual fabrication.

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention more apparent, embodiments of the present invention will be described in detail with reference to the accompanying drawings.

The utility model provides a biotechnological gene detection device, which adopts a movable placing rack and a movable protection mechanism, wherein the movable protection mechanism is used for protecting the detection device externally, when in use, the movable protection mechanism utilizes a hydraulic cylinder to drive a protection cover to lift up, so that the internal structure of the detection device is exposed, the movable placing rack drives a placing plate to slide out through an electric slider, and the detection device is convenient for workers to place and take detection samples and convenient for the workers to use, and the biotechnological gene detection device with reference to figures 1-4 comprises: detection device 100, activity rack 200 and activity protection machanism 300.

Detection device 100 includes frame 110, recess 120, drive assembly 130 and gene detection module 140, recess 120 is seted up to frame 110 bottom, frame 110 both sides board top sets up drive assembly 130, gene detection module 140 is connected with drive assembly 130 expansion end, drive assembly 130 adopts screw motor to drive the movable block and moves, gene detection module 140 connects on the movable block, it removes to drive gene detection module 140 through drive assembly 130, detect the sample, recess 120 is used for installing electronic slide rail 210, make electronic slide rail 210 and electronic slider 220 be located inside recess 120, make frame 110 bottom can support placing board 230.

The movable placing rack 200 is arranged on the groove 120, the movable placing rack 200 comprises an electric sliding rail 210, an electric sliding block 220 and a placing plate 230, the electric sliding rail 210 is arranged in the groove 120, the electric sliding block 220 is arranged on the electric sliding rail 210, the placing plate 230 which is in contact with the bottom of the frame 110 is arranged on the electric sliding block 220, the electric sliding block 220 on the electric sliding rail 210 drives the placing plate 230 to move, the placing plate 230 is pushed out of the frame 110, and the driving assembly 130 and the gene detection module 140 are prevented from influencing workers to take samples above the placing plate 230.

The movable protection mechanism 300 is arranged on the frame 110, the movable protection mechanism 300 comprises a protection cover 310, a bump 320 and a hydraulic cylinder 330, the protection cover 310 and the frame 110 are mutually embedded to form a closed structure, the bump 320 is arranged on two sides of the protection cover 310, the bump 320 is connected and fixed with the hydraulic cylinder 330 on two sides of the frame 110, the protection cover 310 seals the frame 110, the driving assembly 130, the gene detection module 140 and the movable placement frame 200 in the frame 110 are protected, and the hydraulic cylinder 330 drives the protection cover 310 to lift and lower to control the opening and closing of the protection cover 310.

The bottom of the frame 110 is provided with horizontal ground feet which are uniformly distributed, so that the structural stability is improved.

The protective cover 310 is a transparent shell, and a sealing pad is arranged at the connecting position of the protective cover 310 and the frame 110, so that the internal state of the protective cover 310 can be observed conveniently.

The balls are arranged between the frame 110 and the placing plate 230 and embedded at the bottom of the frame 110, so that the friction force applied to the placing plate 230 is reduced, and the placing plate 230 is convenient to move.

When the device is used specifically, the hydraulic cylinder 330 drives the protective cover 310 to lift, so that the inside of the frame 110 is exposed, the electric slider 220 on the electric slide rail 210 drives the placing plate 230 to move, the placing plate 230 is pushed out of the frame 110, after a person places a sample on the placing plate 230, the electric slider 220 drives the placing plate 230 to retract into the frame 110, the driving assembly 130 drives the gene detection module 140 to move, the sample is detected, after the detection is completed, the electric slider 220 drives the placing plate 230 to push out of the frame 110, the person takes the sample out of the placing plate 230, then the placing plate 230 retracts, the protective cover 310 falls down and is closed, and the device is used.

While the utility model has been described above with reference to an embodiment, various modifications may be made and equivalents may be substituted for elements thereof without departing from the scope of the utility model. In particular, the various features of the disclosed embodiments of the utility model may be used in any combination, provided that no structural conflict exists, and the combinations are not exhaustively described in this specification merely for the sake of brevity and resource conservation. Therefore, it is intended that the utility model not be limited to the particular embodiments disclosed, but that the utility model will include all embodiments falling within the scope of the appended claims.
